title: Sonic Plushie
description: Adds cute Sonic Plushie! If you rename carved pumpkin to well, Sonic plushie
body:
So it's a remake of my 2 previous Sonic plushies. This is the definitive version. (orignally published to PMC)
To get him you need to rename a carved pumpkin to "sonic plushie". OptiFine is required to use.
